law_name: Legislative Decree No. 62 of 2013 on Copyright and Neighbouring Rights (replaced Law No. 12/2001)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Art. 19); joint works from last surviving author's death (Art. 20); audiovisual and collective works 50 years from publication (Art. 21)
moral_rights: Right to first publication, attribution or pseudonym, to object to mutilation or prejudicial alteration, and to withdraw the work; perpetual (article numbers not seen)
fair_use_exceptions: Permitted uses without authorization listed in Art. 33 (contents not seen); ideas, methods, laws, court decisions and news not protected (Art. 4) (unconfirmed)
enforcement_body: UNKNOWN (a source names the Ministry of Culture Copyright Office; not confirmed) (unconfirmed)
notes: Official text Arabic only; secondary-source summary. Berne accession 11 Mar 2004 (Paris Act 1971), in force 11 Jun 2004. AGIP FAQ cites year 2016 (apparent typo). WCT/WPPT/TRIPS not verified
